backupReminder.title: 💾 Remember to back up your cards
backupReminder.text: Without an account, they only exist on this phone.

erase.text: Your cards, gift ideas, photos and wishlist will be deleted from this phone.
erase.noBackup: You have not made any backup yet.

backup.savedKeep: Backup saved. Keep this file somewhere safe.
backup.title: Backup
backup.saveText: A file with your birthday cards, their gift ideas, their photos and your wishlist. Store it wherever you like: Files, Drive, an email to yourself.
backup.scopeNote: This backup does not include your events, money pools or shared lists: that data is shared with other people, and restoring it would create duplicates for them. For a full export of everything we hold about you, use "Download my data".

import.mergeOrReplace:
Merge: adds what is missing, without duplicates.
Replace: your current data is deleted.
import.replaceText: Your {{count}} current cards will be replaced by those in the file.
import.unavailable: Import is not available in this version of the app.
import.notBackup: This file is not a BirthReminder backup.
import.tooRecent: This backup comes from a newer version of BirthReminder. Update the app to import it.
import.damaged: The backup is damaged: one card cannot be read.

data.title: My data
data.explain: Without an account, your data only exists on this phone. A backup is a file you keep wherever you like (Files, iCloud Drive, email…): it lets you get everything back on a new phone or after reinstalling the app. Photos included.
data.importSoon: Import will be available in the next version of the app.

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.text: Nothing will be deleted: only cards missing from your account will be added. Those that already exist will be completed.
restore.offline: Connection lost along the way. Start the restore again: what already went through will not be created twice.
restore.allThere: Everything was already in your account.
restore.sectionText: Puts the cards and wishes from a backup back into your account. Nothing is deleted, and a card that is already there is never duplicated: you can restore safely.
restore.unavailable: Restore is not available in this version of the app.

reminders.testScheduled: Test reminder in 5 seconds. You can close the app to see it arrive.
reminders.receiveHint: Birthdays at midnight, name days at 9 am, following each card's settings.
reminders.offText: You denied notifications for BirthReminder: no reminder can be shown. You can turn them back on in your phone's Settings.
reminders.none: No reminder in the next 60 days
reminders.explain: Without an account, your phone schedules the reminders, for the next 60 days. Open BirthReminder from time to time so it can schedule what comes next: if the app stays closed too long, a notification will remind you.

migrate.error: The import could not be completed.
migrate.discardText: Cards from no-account mode will be deleted from this phone. Your account is not affected.
migrate.title: Your cards
migrate.doneText: Your cards are now in your account, on all your devices and on the website. They have been removed from the phone's storage.
migrate.offline: The connection was lost along the way.
migrate.someFailed: Some cards could not be sent:
migrate.retryText: Nothing is lost: they stay on this phone. Try again and the import will pick up where it stopped, without creating duplicates.
migrate.keepOpen: Keep the app open during the import.
migrate.askText: You created these on this phone without an account: {{what}}. Import them into your account to find them everywhere, with their gift ideas, photos and reminders.
migrate.dupHint: A card already in your account (same first name, last name and date) is not created again: its gift ideas are simply added to it.

rem.birthdayTodayBody: Remember to wish them a happy birthday 🎉
rem.birthdaySoonBody: Do not forget to prepare something!
rem.namedayTodayBody: Remember to wish them a happy name day 🎉
rem.namedaySoonBody: Do not forget to wish them!
rem.openBody: Open the app to keep receiving your birthday reminders.
rem.testBody: Your reminders work: you will be notified on the day (midnight for a birthday, 9 am for a name day).

errors.giftGone: This gift idea no longer exists.
errors.namedayTimings: Name day reminders are possible the day before or a week before.
errors.storeTooRecent: Your data was saved by a newer version of BirthReminder. Update the app to access it.

homeTip: Your cards stay on this phone, nothing is sent. Remember to back them up from time to time: Profile → My data. You can create an account later without losing anything.
